_comment: Tool-facing hardware/address declaration for The Pit (Zilec 'roundup' hardware).
FIRST DRAFT modeled from MAME src/mame/taito/roundup.cpp (roundup_state, thepit_main_map,
the roundup() machine_config). Same role as boards/dkong/hardware.json: the single
source of truth the shared Python tools read via --hardware, so tools/ stays game-agnostic.
Numbers are decimal (JSON has no 0x); '_hex' fields are annotations the loader ignores.
TODO (need a MAME golden run to measure): dsw0 expected value, boot/NMI landmark cycles,
and confirm the exact stateRegions the Lua instrument dumps vs the engine.

screen._note: native raster 256H x 224V; ROT90 for display, same as DK

_timing_note: pixel clock 6.144MHz, htotal 384, vtotal 264 -> 60.606Hz; Z80 18.432/3/2 = 3.072MHz -> 50688 cyc/frame (identical to DK)

writeRanges.name: control
writeRanges._hex: 0xB000-0xB007 LS259 mainlatch: b0=NMI mask, b2=coin lockout, b3=sound enable, b6=flipX+mux, b7=flipY

writeRanges.name: sound_latch
writeRanges._hex: 0xB800 soundlatch write to the audio Z80 (read = watchdog reset)

dsw0._hex_expected: 0x00 -- all default dip settings (1C_1C, fast, long, no flip, upright, 3 lives, tests off)

_controlByte_hex: 0xC3 -- ROM 0x0000 first byte (JP nn, the reset vector); config-probe that the program ROM loaded

z80Reset._hex: MAME Z80 reset: AF=0x0040 (Z flag set), IX=IY=0xFFFF, rest 0 -- same for every MAME Z80

_landmarks_todo: measure boot-init-done and first-vblank-NMI cycles from a MAME golden run, as boards/dkong/hardware.json has
